//: EMULATOR-ONLY CONFIG. scripts/start-dev.ps1 and `npm --prefix firebase run test:functions` pass it with `--config firebase.emulators.json`. It exists because the emulators need the PERMISSIVE rulesets, and firebase.json, which `firebase deploy` reads, points at the production ones (T105). The Storage emulator refuses to start under a real project id without a `storage.rules` key, so this file names storage.rules, the permissive emulator ruleset; it has no Firestore rules key, so the Firestore emulator allows everything. Never point firebase.json at either: that would deploy them to production. The production rulesets are storage.rules.prod and firestore.rules.prod, deployed by the merge workflow.
